rated_messages.input_message: Don't test yourself needlessly. If this social situation gets uncomfortable then leave briefly if you can. It really helps and it's fine to do it more than once!
When a craving hits, keep your hands busy by doing the dishes or taking out the trash. Small chores will help pass the time during a craving.
Practice staying in this location without smoking. Just notice your urge. Practicing this will weaken this trigger with time. Just think of it as practice.
Take a deep breath and let it out slowly. Notice that you are completely OK for this one breath. Do it again.

Add the phrase “I’m having the thought that…” in front of your unhelpful thoughts. For example, “I’m having the thought that I need a cigarette.” Your thoughts are not always true or helpful! They are just thoughts.

Don't let anyone tell you how you should or shouldn't feel today. You feel how you feel and that's it. If you're happy and grateful then enjoy the moment, if you're angry and frustrated, know that this will pass.
Tell yourself, “I am going to quit smoking soon.” Say it out loud. Say to yourself, “I am too strong to continue smoking for the rest of my life."
Instead of smoking, keep your fingers busy by scrolling through your phone.
If you're stuck at home and physical activity doesn't interest you, try gaming, needlework, drawing, or journaling.
